detail.title: Mosaic tile paving device
detail.abstract: A mosaic tile paving device is provided. The mosaic tile paving device includes suckers and a handle. The paving device is characterized in that: Multiple suckers are installed on the vacuuming shell. The suckers and the mosaic tiles can be fixed together or separated by changing the air volume in the vacuuming shell. A handle is connected on the vacuuming shell.
